stem: The webshop had 24,000 sessions with at least one add to cart, and 36,000 add-to-cart events. Checkout began in 9,000 of those sessions. An analyst divides 9,000 by 36,000. What does that do to the cart-to-checkout step conversion?

options.text: It comes out too low, since one session can add to cart several times
It comes out right, since each event is one more chance to begin checkout
It comes out too high, since events leave out sessions that added only once
It comes out too low, since checkouts must be counted as events as well
